question_cn: 2026 世界杯 F 组小组赛：瑞典 vs 突尼斯（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group F: Sweden vs Tunisia (three-way result, 90 minutes)?
one_liner_cn: 瑞典凭约克雷斯+伊萨克的锋线优势小幅占优，但突尼斯防守极稳且瑞典状态起伏大，三路都不该被排除。
one_liner_en: Sweden hold a modest edge via the Gyokeres-Isak forward line, but Tunisia's rock-solid defence and Sweden's volatility keep every outcome live.

key_reasons.cn: 瑞典锋线档次高于其 Elo 排名：约克雷斯随阿森纳夺 2025-26 英超冠军，附加赛戴帽并绝杀波兰，伊萨克同样在阵。
key_reasons.en: Sweden's forwards outclass their Elo rank: Gyokeres won the 2025-26 Premier League with Arsenal, scored a playoff hat-trick and the late winner vs Poland; Isak is also in the squad.

key_reasons.cn: 突尼斯预选赛零失球但 1 月临阵换帅，拉穆奇备战时间有限且名单大幅轮换，赢球上限受压。
key_reasons.en: Tunisia conceded zero goals in qualifying but changed coach in January; Lamouchi has had limited preparation with a much-changed squad, capping their win ceiling.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 84 分（1712 vs 1628）+ 中立场地，统计模型给出瑞典 46.2/平 25.4/突尼斯 28.5 的基线。
key_reasons.en: An 84-point Elo gap (1712 vs 1628) on neutral ground yields a statistical baseline of Sweden 46.2 / Draw 25.4 / Tunisia 28.5.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, no host bonus, neutral venue) -> p_stat Sweden 46.2/Draw 25.4/Tunisia 28.5; bounded evidence adjustment (total ~4.9pp of max 8pp) for Sweden's elite forwards vs Tunisia's coaching upheaval and defensive solidity; renormalized to 48/26/26. No market inputs of any kind.
